column1: Welcome to the Pain Regulation Digitimer Task!
Please relax and remain still during the experiment while we record your brain activity.

In this task, you will perform three pain regulation techniques: observe, facilitate, and inhibit. Each technique will be completed at two stimulation levels (Level 1 and Level 4).\n\nBefore each trial, an on screen instruction will explain how to perform the technique.

During each regulation period, you will rate the experimental pain delivered to your arm on a scale from 0 (no pain) to 10 (worst possible pain).\n\nYou may adjust your rating at any time if the sensation changes.

Each technique will be completed five times, followed by a confidence rating where you indicate how well you feel you performed the technique.\n\nThere will be a 60 second break between each technique block.
The state measure will begin on the following screen.\n\nPlease let us know if you have any remaining questions.
